what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from El Salvador in Belize: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 950 Salvadoran asylum seekers in Belize, 0.9% of all asylum seekers from El Salvador.
Refugees from El Salvador, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for El Salvador in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 21 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 2201, at the end of 2018, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belize.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Belize only.
